response.sql: SELECT per_rental.store_id, AVG(per_rental.total_amount) AS avg_total_per_rental, AVG(per_rental.payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM (SELECT i.store_id, p.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY i.store_id, p.rental_id) AS per_rental GROUP BY per_rental.store_id;
